Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Main{
    public static void main(String args[])
    {
        int input1[] = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6};
        int n = 10;
        int ans[] = generateNextSequence(n, input1);
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            System.out.println(ans[i] + " ");
        }
    }
    
    public static int[] generateNextSequence(int n, int input1[])
    {
        int ans[] = new int[n];
        for(int i=0;i<input1.length;i++)
        {
            ans[i] = input1[i];
        }
        for(int k = input1.length;k<n;k++)
        {
            ans[k] = ans[k-1] + ans[k-2];
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
